verdict.summary: The change correctly adds a feature-matrix leg that executes the default-OFF vc-bridge tests and supplies non-self-referential W3C interoperability coverage for both supported cryptosuites. The fixture byte hashes match the published constants. The tests exercise the public hashing, verification, token-dispatch, and ingest paths, and include meaningful negative mutations for signatures, credential content, proof configurations, and suite confusion, so the positive verification is not vacuous. Scope and audit-status claims are appropriately limited to off-circuit ingest-time verification and explicitly disclaim in-circuit/query soundness and external audit. I found no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect in the diff. The Rust test suite could not be executed in this review environment because cargo is unavailable.
